nodes.name: Pdene gel formation
nodes.procedure: 10 mg of Pd(acac)2 and 8 mg W(CO)6 were introduced in 10 ml of CH3COOH by ultrasonication. The solution was bubbled in a CO flow for 10 min and was then heated at 50 °C. Pdene gels were acquired at the bottom for 1 h.

nodes.name: β-PdHene gel formation
nodes.procedure: By adding 10 mL DMF to Pdene gels, the vial was maintained at 160 °C for 16 h to acquire β-PdHene gels. Hydrogen insertion is achieved under solvothermal conditions in dimethylformamide (DMF). Subsequently, β-PdHene gels were gained by in situ insertion of hydrogen atoms formed from the decomposition of DMF on Pdene gels at 160 °C.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM image displays thin and wrinkled 2D graphene-like morphology with average lateral dimension up to several hundred nanometers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Highangle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of β-PdHene aerogels display a thin and wrinkled two-dimensional (2D) graphene-like morphology...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show thin and wrinkled 2D graphene-like morphology; SAED pattern shows polycrystalline structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Highangle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) and transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of β-PdHene aerogels display... The selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern shows the polycrystalline structure...

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM measures thickness of β-PdHene aerogels at about 1.26 nm, equivalent to 5–6 atomic layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The thickness of β-PdHene aerogels is measured to about 1.26 nm by atomic force microscopy (AFM), equivalent to 5–6 atomic layers...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM and FFT pattern show (111)-oriented fcc structure with lattice spacing of 0.237 nm attributed to (111) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image and the corresponding fast Fourier transform (FFT) pattern suggest the β-PdHene aerogels present a (111)-oriented face-centered cubic (fcc) structure. Distinct lattice spacing of 0.237 nm can be attributed to the (111) planes...

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface area of β-PdHene aerogels is 48.9 m²/g, slightly smaller than Pdene at 64.7 m²/g; shows micropores, mesopores, and macropores.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface areas and porosity features of Pdene and β-PdHene aerogels were evaluated by the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) analysis... The surface area of β-PdHene aerogels (48.9 m² g⁻¹) is slightly smaller than that of Pdene (64.7 m² g⁻¹)...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show diffraction peaks shift negatively with increasing reaction temperature from 120°C to 160°C, indicating more hydrogen insertion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern shows that the more negatively the diffraction peaks shift, the more hydrogen atoms are inserted with the reaction temperature increasing from 120°C to 160°C (Fig. 1h).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS Pd 3d spectra show metallic Pd state with positive binding energy shifts (0.36 eV for β-PdHene vs Pdene); valence band spectra show half-band width narrowing from 4.53 eV (Pdene) to 4.14 eV (β-PdHene) and lowest d-band center.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface electronic structure of Pd in the Pdene and different phases of PdHene aerogels was performed by XPS in Fig. 4a. The Pd 3d XPS spectra show that Pd in all metallene materials exists in the metallic state... Pd 3d peaks of β-PdHene show more positive shifts of 0.36 V than that of Pdene... The surface valence band spectra analysis verifies that β-PdHene owns the lowest εd position...

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS determines H/Pd ratios: α-PdHene 0.08, mixed-phase PdHene 0.28, β-PdHene 0.43.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The element contents were obtained by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS)... The H and Pd ratio in the α-PdHene, mixed-phase PdHene, and β-PdHene aerogels is calculated to be 0.08, 0.28, and 0.43, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EIS shows β-PdHene has smaller charge transfer resistance R1 and hydrogen adsorption resistance R2 than other catalysts, with significantly increased EIS-derived Tafel slopes indicating slower hydrogen adsorption kinetics.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The hydrogen adsorption kinetics was carried out by operando electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) measurement... the values of R1 of β-PdHene aerogels are smaller than those of other electrocatalysts... Comparatively, the EIS-derived Tafel slopes of β-PdHene aerogels are significantly increased...

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando CV shows hydrogen desorption peak positively shifts with scan rate; β-PdHene exhibits declined slope of peak position vs scan rate, indicating drastically enhanced hydrogen desorption kinetics.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To explore the hydrogen desorption behavior, the operando CV tests... were determined. The hydrogen desorption peak is positively shifted with an increment in the scan rate... The declined slope of β-PdHene aerogels exhibits its drastically enhanced hydrogen desorption kinetics...
